findings.title: The latest full-scope capture is not live/current
findings.detail: OLBG and official data were captured at 2026-10-23T21:36:58Z / 2026-10-23T21:36:58Z. This review is frozen at 2026-10-24T17:10:06Z; an OLBG row with a future timestamp is not proof that the market is still open now.

findings.title: Most source-desk High labels do not meet the 70% screen
findings.detail: Of 75 prediction cards labelled High, 67 have a stated selection probability below 70%; 8 reach 70%. The source script grades a composite confidence index, not the selected outcome probability.

findings.title: Old prediction cards include matches that had already started
findings.detail: 33 of 75 prediction start times are at or before the review time 2026-10-24T17:10:06Z; they must not appear as upcoming picks.

findings.title: No prediction passes the complete release gate
findings.detail: 5 future text cards pass the numeric p≥70% and American-odds window screen, but 0 have an exact current OLBG crosswalk. Prediction claims and line inputs were not independently reconciled, so 0 are release-ready.

findings.title: The captured OLBG fixture list has no future rows in six requested categories
findings.detail: Only 9 of the 15 requested sports have a row with a start time after the review instant in the 23 October OLBG capture. Zero does not prove that OLBG has no such market today; it means this snapshot supplies no future row.

findings.title: Most official schedule rows are not reconciled to an OLBG event
findings.detail: The source desk contains 114 schedule rows, but only 22 have an OLBG reference, and the reference-generation routine uses first-word substring checks. One explicit future reference is wrong: FB-CRK-NZIND-T3 points to event 188832, whose OLBG timestamp is 24 October rather than the desk row's 27 October.

findings.title: Some official citations are paired with an OLBG capture as their evidence
findings.detail: Three United Rugby Championship rows and one Pakistan v England cricket row point to an OLBG hub capture target rather than a captured governing-body event source. A source URL string and a capture hash do not establish that the captured bytes support the cited row. The PCB's official schedule is linked on the current OLBG list for Pakistan v England; the three URC rows remain unreconciled.

findings.title: The 452 reported fair-line families are not current offered prices
findings.detail: All 452 market families and 997 outcomes are internally normalized and their displayed decimal/American conversions were rechecked. The file contains no live bookmaker quote, and this audit did not independently reconcile the hard-coded means, sigmas, runner strengths, injury assumptions, or all source facts used as inputs. These are historical desk estimates, not prices currently offered on OLBG.

findings.title: Injury and availability statements are not individually evidenced in the prediction cards
findings.detail: The prediction records contain one match-source URL and an injury-note field, but no per-claim evidence pointer. Absence of a roster entry is not proof of fitness or non-injury; no such statement is promoted here.

findings.title: Three OLBG hub pages were spot-checked but not saved as reproducible live captures
findings.detail: Live hub HTML was fetched for Volleyball, Cricket and Handball during this audit. The page bodies use relative Today/Tomorrow time labels and the fetch tool did not provide an exact retrieval timestamp or raw response file. These observations confirm that a live refresh is feasible, but are not used as an updated fixture dataset or as proof of event time/market availability.
